publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
citation: NOAA NCEI (2022), ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model, doi:10.25921/fd45-gt74
terms: NOAA's dataset metadata permits free use and redistribution. Supplied without warranty; not intended for legal use. This derived grid is not endorsed by NOAA.
processing: Select every tenth row/column from NOAA's 60-arcsecond ice-surface grid; round physical EGM2008 metres to signed Int16, away from zero at half metres. No invented elevations. Not a block-average or a 15-arcsecond distribution.
binaryLayout: Little endian: Int32 width=2160, Int32 height=1080, Float64 south=-89.90833333333333, Float64 west=0.09166666666666856, Float64 step=1/6 degree, then 2332800 Int16 elevations. Rows south to north, columns eastward 0..360.
limitations: 10 arcminutes is approximately 18.5 km north-south; fine meshes cannot recover smaller features. Nearest-sample projection preserves source values but not all straits/lakes. Ice-surface elevations are not subglacial bedrock. Climate and hydrology are simulated, not observational benchmarks. Procedural plate diagnostics are not actual Earth plates.
